Maya (Backend): Hey folks — accepted the org invite yesterday but when I try to push to ssh://git@github.com/redwood-inference/backend.git I get permission denied. Can someone confirm who to ping for repo write access?
Eli (Platform): @Maya can you paste the exact error and whether you used SSH or HTTPS? Also run `gh auth status` and `ssh -T git@github.com` to check auth.
Maya (Backend): Error is `Permission denied (publickey). fatal: Could not read from remote repository.` I did add my key to GitHub earlier but I have two GH accounts (maya-personal & maya-work). Not sure which one the invite attached to.
Jo (People Ops): We sent the invite to maya@redwood.ai. If you accepted on a different account the org mapping won't apply. Can you check https://github.com/settings/emails to confirm primary email?
Maya (Backend): Primary is maya@gmail.com right now. Ugh. Changing the primary to maya@redwood.ai and verifying now.
Eli (Platform): After that, reauthorize SSO for redwood-inference and then re-sync teams. Sometimes GitHub caches the session; a logout/login helps: `gh auth logout` -> `gh auth login`.
Maya (Backend): Did the email change and reauthorized SSO. `ssh -T` still says Permission denied though.
Eli (Platform): Did you add the SSH key to the work account? Keys are per-account. If the key is only on maya-personal you'll need to add it to maya-work or generate a new key and add to the correct account.
Maya (Backend): Added same public key to maya-work and re-run `ssh -T` -> "Hi maya-work! You've successfully authenticated." Trying push... still blocked with 403 when pushing to the repo URL via HTTPS, SSH works locally but CI showed 403 earlier.
Jo (People Ops): I see your account in the org but mapped to the viewers team by default. If you need write access to backend, I can request promotion to eng-backend. We also require 2FA; can you confirm it's enabled?
Maya (Backend): Enabled 2FA (TOTP) earlier. If viewers is the default, pls escalate — I need to push a tiny config change.
Eli (Platform): I gave a temporary team write grant to eng-backend-temp for maya so you can push now; will revoke after PR. Try again.
security-bot: audit: temporary team eng-backend-temp created and user maya-work added (id: tmp-778).
Maya (Backend): Push succeeded! Opened PR and will follow the review flow. Thanks all.
Jo (People Ops): I'll promote you to eng-backend after you finish the quick security quiz tomorrow. Noted: update onboarding doc to stress primary email and SSH key mapping.
Maya (Backend): Great — leaving notes on the checklist; happy to help update docs. :thumbsup:
